message:
feat(seo): give the crawler a way into the item pages

The site was in Search Console for three months but only the home page was
ever indexed. Reason: the catalog is rendered client-side, and the prerendered
item pages linked only back to the home page, so nothing in the HTML pointed at
the other 329. The sitemap was the only path to them.

- every item page now links to 12 related items (same category first, then the
  most valuable overall), in both languages
- new static /items/ and /ru/items/ indexes listing all 330 items grouped by
  category, linked from the site footer
- both index pages are in the sitemap (664 URLs now)
- scripts/check-links.cjs verifies the link graph after a build
author: BSS Index Developer
